judged_edits.reason: N516 and N47 agree that the bowl's terminal meets the bar at a hairline, with a white notch running almost into the eye. The hairline (about 34 units) matches the face's other bowl joins and is kept; the notch's inner end, narrower than about 30 units, is closed so that the eye reads as closed at text sizes. The notch's mouth is kept.

production_impressions.method: Repeated impressions on the Letraset production sheets, each registered onto the round-02 trace by its own affine transform (absorbing the photograph's local perspective), re-registered twice onto their mean with the frame pinned to the round-02 trace, averaged on a 1/8 trace-unit grid; edge at one level per sheet between the mean's backing and ink; fitted with curvefit3.contour_to_curves4.
production_impressions.caveat: The impressions are one artwork printed many times: averaging lowers print and photographic noise; it is not independent confirmation of the design. Proportions and placement remain those of the round-02 trace.
